description: This file sets up and runs a conversational bot using Pipecat framework, integrating speech-to-text, text-to-speech, language model, and transport mechanisms for a WebRTC call scenario.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds the context messages for the language model.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs the LLM context with user parameters and strategies.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with its parameters and execution settings.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of a pipeline.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Represents a frame for running the LLM within the pipeline.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Transport parameters for WebSocket via FastAPI.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy for stopping user turns based on analysis.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Initializes and runs the bot with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, setting up transport and starting the bot process.
